audience: marketplace operations teams with API-enabled Channable order connections

useCases.title: Review unshipped orders
useCases.text: Find orders awaiting shipment and inspect their details before fulfilment.

useCases.title: Review marketplace returns
useCases.text: Find returns in a selected date range and inspect a return before updating it.

useCases.title: Send confirmed tracking details
useCases.text: Mark an order or selected items shipped using the confirmed carrier and tracking code. This propagates to the marketplace.

useCases.title: Set marketplace stock levels
useCases.text: Set the whole stock value for up to 50 offers. The new availability is sent to every connected marketplace in the project.

useCases.title: Review order performance
useCases.text: Read order counts, costs and revenue for the project or a selected order connection.
